profile.about_headline: Turning messy data into clear, defensible business decisions.
profile.about_text:
I’m a Computer Science graduate specializing in AI & Machine Learning, with a growing focus on data and product analytics. I enjoy working with raw data, finding the story behind the numbers, and turning that story into something people can actually use.

My hands-on experience includes SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, data cleaning, exploratory analysis, KPI reporting, and dashboard development. Through internships and personal projects, I’ve worked with datasets ranging from thousands to 1M+ records, giving me practical exposure to data quality, analysis, visualization, and business problem-solving.

I’m still early in my career, but I’ve never wanted to learn only from theory. I build projects, experiment with different tools, question my results, and keep improving. My goal is simple: understand the problem first, let the data speak, and turn the analysis into a useful decision.
profile.status_text: Open to Work • Data & Product Analyst Roles

projects.title: Insight360 — Enterprise Analytics for Customer Retention, Service Excellence & Workforce Inclusion
projects.short_description: A multi-dashboard Power BI project exploring customer service, customer churn and retention, and workforce diversity across 3 business areas.
projects.full_description: Insight360 brought together 3 business areas, 3 datasets, and 3 Power BI dashboards into one analytics project. I worked with the data to transform raw information into interactive dashboards that make business performance easier to explore and understand.
projects.problem_statement: Business stakeholders lacked a unified analytics view across three disconnected departments: Call Centre Service Quality, Customer Retention & Churn, and Workforce Diversity & Inclusion.
projects.objective: Design an integrated 3-dashboard Power BI suite transforming multi-departmental datasets into actionable executive KPI reporting.
projects.dataset: 3 distinct enterprise datasets covering call center interactions, customer retention logs, and workforce demographics.
projects.methodology: Data cleaning → Power Query transformation → Data modeling → DAX calculations → KPI development → Dashboard design → Business analysis.
projects.key_findings: Identified root causes of customer service bottlenecks and leading indicators influencing customer churn across subscription tiers.
projects.business_impact: Delivered 3 comprehensive interactive dashboards (Call Centre, Churn, Diversity) enabling management to explore operational health in real time.

projects.title: SQL Business Insights Project
projects.short_description: A practical SQL project answering commercial business questions through structured queries, joins, CTEs, and window functions.
projects.full_description: I built this project to move beyond simply practicing SQL syntax. The focus was on using SQL the way an analyst would in production — exploring data, joining tables, calculating metrics, identifying patterns, and turning query results into actionable business insights.
projects.problem_statement: Transactional database records needed structured aggregation to surface customer purchasing patterns and revenue trends for business stakeholders.
projects.objective: Structure complex SQL queries to explore customer transactions, calculate cohort metrics, and generate clear commercial summaries.
projects.dataset: Relational business database spanning customers, transactions, orders, and product line items.
projects.methodology: Data exploration → SQL transformations → Joins → Aggregations → CTEs → Window functions → Business analysis.
projects.key_findings: Uncovered key product velocity patterns and customer retention segments directly from relational database tables.
projects.business_impact: Created structured, reusable analytical SQL queries that streamline recurring monthly reporting.

projects.title: T20 Cricket Batsmen Performance Analysis
projects.short_description: An interactive Power BI dashboard designed to explore, compare, and benchmark T20 batsmen performance across key match scenarios.
projects.full_description: I used cricket as a way to explore how data can turn individual performances into a bigger picture. The dashboard makes it easier to compare batsmen across different performance metrics instead of looking at statistics one by one.
projects.problem_statement: Standard cricket averages fail to capture contextual batting impact across different phases and match situations.
projects.objective: Build a comparative Power BI dashboard evaluating strike rates, boundary percentages, and player impact.
projects.dataset: T20 cricket match datasets containing player scoring summaries and situational stats.
projects.methodology: Data preparation → Power Query → DAX measures → KPI development → Player comparison → Visualization.
projects.key_findings: Highlighted player performance variances under pressure and identified top-performing batsmen across phases.
projects.business_impact: Created an intuitive visual dashboard allowing users to filter, compare, and benchmark players simultaneously.

projects.title: Supermarket Sales Analysis
projects.short_description: A Python-based exploratory data analysis (EDA) of supermarket sales data to uncover patterns in sales and customer transactions.
projects.full_description: This was one of my projects for getting more comfortable with Python-based analysis. Rather than jumping straight into modeling, I focused on understanding the data first — what was happening, where patterns appeared, and what questions the dataset could answer.
projects.problem_statement: Supermarket transaction data contained untapped patterns regarding customer purchasing frequency, peak hours, and product line margins.
projects.objective: Perform exploratory data analysis with Python to uncover transaction patterns and branch performance metrics.
projects.dataset: Transactional sales records across supermarket product lines, customer types, and payment methods.
projects.methodology: Data inspection → Cleaning → Exploratory analysis → Visualization → Pattern identification.
projects.key_findings: Identified peak transaction windows, popular product lines, and branch revenue contributions.
projects.business_impact: Delivered visual data summaries with clear findings on customer purchasing trends.

projects.title: Traffic Sign Detection
projects.short_description: A CNN-based deep learning project for recognizing and classifying traffic signs from images.
projects.full_description: This project gave me practical exposure to computer vision and helped me understand how a model learns visual patterns rather than simply working with rows and columns of data.
projects.problem_statement: Autonomous systems require reliable visual recognition of roadside traffic signs under varied lighting and angles.
projects.objective: Build a convolutional neural network (CNN) model to classify traffic sign images into designated categories.
projects.dataset: Image dataset of traffic signs across multiple classes and conditions.
projects.methodology: Image preprocessing → Dataset preparation → CNN development → Training → Evaluation → Prediction.
projects.key_findings: Achieved effective multi-class image classification with convolutional feature extractors.
projects.business_impact: Demonstrated practical computer vision architecture for image classification tasks.

projects.title: Bike Sharing Demand Prediction
projects.short_description: A machine-learning project exploring historical bike-sharing behavior and demand prediction.
projects.full_description: I used this project to explore how historical patterns can be used to anticipate future demand. It helped me connect exploratory analysis with machine-learning modeling and understand the importance of preparing the data before building a model.
projects.problem_statement: Urban bike-sharing operators need accurate demand forecasts based on weather conditions, seasonal patterns, and time of day.
projects.objective: Develop a predictive regression model using historical rental records and environmental factors.
projects.dataset: Historical hourly and daily bike rental demand data with meteorological variables.
projects.methodology: Data preparation → Exploratory analysis → Feature analysis → Model development → Evaluation → Prediction.
projects.key_findings: Temperature, hour of day, and working day indicators showed the highest correlation with rental spikes.
projects.business_impact: Built a structured demand forecasting pipeline connecting data preparation with predictive evaluation.
